details.description: Claude v1 (Amazon Bedrock model ID anthropic.claude-v1, with no dated snapshot suffix) is Anthropic's first-generation Claude model line. Anthropic's Claude 2 model card evaluates Claude 1.3, the final and longest-deployed v1.x snapshot, as a general-purpose, text-only conversational model built with RLHF and Constitutional AI, with a 100K-token context window. It was superseded by Claude 2 in July 2023, and Anthropic retired Claude 1.0-1.3 and Claude Instant 1.x from its own Claude API on November 6, 2024; Amazon Bedrock, which sets its own schedule, no longer lists Claude v1 among its currently supported models.
advantages: Scores 90.0% on ARC-Challenge (5-shot science questions), per Anthropic's Claude 2 model card.
Scores 88.8% on RACE-H (5-shot reading comprehension), the highest of the three models compared, per Anthropic's Claude 2 model card.
Scores 84.1% on QuALITY (5-shot long-story Q&A), the highest of the three models compared, per Anthropic's Claude 2 model card.
Anthropic's model card describes Claude models as steerable and conversational, well suited to creative or literary use cases.
disadvantages: Anthropic retired Claude 1.0-1.3 and Claude Instant 1.x from the Claude API on November 6, 2024, recommending Claude Haiku 4.5 as a replacement.
Text only: no image input, unlike later Claude models.
Anthropic's model card says Claude models 'perform less strongly on low-resource languages.'
100K-token context window, half of Claude 2's 200K, per Anthropic's Claude 2.1 model card appendix.
use_cases: Writing, editing, outlining, and summarizing text.
Coding assistance, though Anthropic's model card says this model lagged the state of the art on coding tasks.
Providing helpful advice across a broad range of subjects.
Creative or literary use cases, with steerable tone.

notes: Bedrock's model ID 'anthropic.claude-v1' has no dated snapshot suffix; identified with Claude 1.3, the final and longest-deployed v1.x release, based on Anthropic's July/November 2023 model card, which evaluates 'Claude 1.3' by name as the deployed non-instant model of that era (benchmark table in section 4.3). Some uncertainty remains about whether Bedrock's undated ID ever pointed to an earlier v1.0-1.2 snapshot. Catalog lists no deprecation_date for this target; Anthropic itself retired the v1.x line from its own Claude API on November 6, 2024, and as of today (2026-09-24) Claude v1 no longer appears in Amazon Bedrock's current 'Models at a glance' listing (which starts at Claude 3 Haiku), suggesting Bedrock access has also ended, though we found no Bedrock-specific EOL date or announcement to cite.
